These **cubits** were a unit of measurement corresponding to the distance between an average person’s elbow and middle fingertip, or about 46 centimeters or 18 inches. A **handbreadth** was a unit of measurement corresponding to the width of an average person’s hand, or about 8 centimeters or 3 inches. Ezekiel means that each cubit of this measuring reed was a regular cubit plus a handbreadth, or about 54 centimeters or 21 inches, so that the whole reed was about 3.2 meters or 10.5 feet long. If it would be helpful to your readers, you could express these lengths in modern measurements, either in the text or a footnote. Alternate translation: [the measuring reed was about 3.2 meters or 10.5 feet long]
